name: print-social-team-growing-lightbulb-plant-instagram-post-green-gradient
title: Instagram post illustration of a team watering and presenting a giant lightbulb growing as a plant, on a green gradient
whatItIs: An Instagram post mockup with a bright green gradient background showing three flat-illustrated people tending a potted plant whose leaves support a giant red lightbulb: one waters it from a ladder, one presents it on an easel, one works at a laptop, shown with a follow button, engagement icons and a caption.
whatItMeans: Optimistic and literal; growing an idea as a plant makes 'nurturing innovation' a concrete, friendly visual metaphor.
techniques: Turn an abstract concept (an idea) into a literal growing plant.
Give each team member a distinct supporting action around the metaphor.
Present the illustration inside a realistic social post mockup.

vocabulary.definition: An image standing in for an abstract idea, like growth for innovation.
An illustration shown inside a realistic social app frame.
